summary: 0.2.8-beta.2 adds audit-driven safety corrections while preserving API 1.0.0 and the published generator timing correction.
changes: Restore rejected CEE state coherently, including shared alternator windings, and isolate unsupported addon endpoints before callbacks.
Fall back safely when bounded restoration is disabled; reject invalid multimeter input without changing the previous selection.
Guard native matrix allocation and growth on Windows/Linux, and reject duplicate entries in release-equivalence comparisons.
installation: Use Minecraft 1.21.1, NeoForge 21.1.265, Java 21, Create 6.0.10, CEE 1.1.4, Power Grid 0.6.2 and Architectury 13.0.11. Set PG multiTicks to 16. Match server and client mod versions.
optional_installation: The combined Pinout Stationary Yard requires CC:Tweaked 1.121.0 and Pinout 0.2.1. Fuse and rotary-selector circuit examples require Power Components 1.3.0.
